overview_description.description:
Khabri is a digital audio platform for content in vernacular.

Ita app allows content creators to create channels and programmes that reach vernacular listeners.

Aankit Roy, Pulkit Sharma, and Sandeep Singh launched the company in Haryana, Haryana in 2016.
